name: InclusionAI
short: InclusionAI (Ant Group's AGI initiative) serves its Ling (general-text) and Ming (multimodal) model families through the Ant Ling developer platform — pay-as-you-go in CNY with OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs, and discounted access via OpenRouter/ZenMux.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Per 1M tokens (CNY), list price then promo price: Ling-3.1-flash ¥2.00→¥0.50 in / ¥6.00→¥1.50 out; Ling-3.0-flash & Ling-3.0-flash-VL ¥0.50→¥0.14 in / ¥1.50→¥0.42 out; Ming-Image-0.1-Design ¥0.10→¥0.03 per image. Note: Free quotas / trials require Alipay real-name identity verification (passport / Chinese national ID).
